name: RTVC
body: HSTS, a CSP from default-src 'self', nosniff, and a Permissions-Policy that turns off camera, mic, and location. But the search field relies on a placeholder, "Buscar", with no label to announce.
lesson: Add a <label> or aria-label to every input. Placeholders vanish while typing and aren't reliably announced.
summary: www.rtvc.gov.co scores 82 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 21 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /quienes-somos/quienes-somos, /quienes-somos/informacion-general, /quienes-somos/mision-vision-principios-y-valores and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / Organization lacks url, /quienes-somos/quienes-somos Organization lacks url, /quienes-somos/informacion-general Organization lacks url and 17 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 59 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 6 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /quienes-somos/informacion-general, /quienes-somos/perfiles-directivos, /contratacion/aspirantes, /quienes-somos/directorio/funcionarios-colaboradores and 2 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:image
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 625 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
